title: Austin Appoints New Acting Court Clerk
summary:
*   A special meeting was convened for an executive session to discuss sensitive matters including land acquisition, ongoing litigation, and personnel issues.
*   The primary public action involved a significant personnel change: Joseph L. Lessard was immediately appointed as the new Acting Municipal Court Clerk.
*   This appointment resulted in the immediate transfer of all responsibilities from the previous Municipal Court Clerk to Mr. Lessard.
